shortDescription: BPSSC has released Company Commander (Special) Recruitment 2026 Advt. No. 11/2026 for 65 posts in Bihar Home Guard. Online applications are scheduled from 10 September 2026 to 10 October 2026.
content:
Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission (BPSSC) has released Advt. No. 11/2026 for selection of Company Commander (Special) in Bihar Home Guard under the Home Department (Special), Government of Bihar.

Eligible candidates can apply online from 10 September 2026 to 10 October 2026. The recruitment has 65 posts. Read the full notification carefully for age limit, qualification, physical standards, PET, fee and selection procedure before applying.

Important dates

  • Application begins: 10 September 2026
  • Last date to apply: 10 October 2026
  • Last date for fee payment: 10 October 2026
  • Exam date: As per schedule
  • Admit card: Before examination

Eligibility

Candidates must hold a Bachelor's Degree in any stream from a recognized university in India. The notification also specifies physical standards and physical efficiency requirements.

Physical standards

  • Male height: 165 cm
  • Female height: 155 cm
  • Male chest: 81-86 cm
  • Male: 1.6 km run in 6 minutes 30 seconds
  • Female: 1 km run in 6 minutes

Vacancy details

Company Commander (Special): 65 posts. Category-wise vacancies are UR 27, EWS 06, EBC 11, BC 08, BC Female 02, SC 10 and ST 01.

How to apply

  1. Open the official BPSSC Home Guard recruitment page.
  2. Complete registration and fill the application form.
  3. Upload the required documents and pay the examination fee.
  4. Review all details before final submission.
  5. Print the submitted application for future reference.
editorNotes: Online application is scheduled to start on 10 September 2026. Verify the official BPSSC notification before paying the fee or submitting the form.
importantInstructions: Read the complete Advt. No. 11/2026 notification, check physical standards and keep scanned photograph, signature and certificates ready before applying.
